summary: Backend-only retest of the 3 fixes from iteration 2 (X-Forwarded-For aware rate-limit key_func, custom RateLimitExceeded handler returning 'detail', new /public/og-image.svg). Backend restarted before each run to reset the in-memory limiter. Full pytest suite run serially: 33/33 PASS (25 in backend_test.py + 8 in the rewritten tests/test_rate_limit.py). VERIFIED: (1) Bucket separation - 5 POSTs /api/contact with X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4 -> 200,200,200,200,200 and the 6th -> 429; immediately after, 5 POSTs with X-Forwarded-For: 5.6.7.8 -> all 200 (independent bucket) while 1.2.3.4 was still 429 at the same time; the 6th for 5.6.7.8 -> 429. Reproduced independently via curl with a third IP (77.77.77.77): req1-5 = 200, req6 = 429. So the shared-proxy-bucket CRITICAL defect of iteration 2 is FIXED. (2) 429 response: content-type application/json, body exactly {"detail": "Hai inviato troppi messaggi. Riprova tra qualche minuto."} (confirmed via pytest assertion on r.json() and raw curl -i). (3) GET /og-image.svg -> 200, content-type image/svg+xml, 1933 bytes, valid <svg> root. (4) /api/health is NOT rate limited (8 consecutive 200s). REGRESSIONS OK: honeypot ('website' filled) -> fake 200 with throwaway uuid and ZERO documents in MongoDB (log 'Honeypot triggered - contact rejected (IP 9.9.9.9)' shows the new key function is used in logging too); valid submit -> 200 with only {id, created_at} and full field-by-field persistence check in MongoDB with no 'website' field and no _id leak; GET /privacy -> 200 text/html. Frontend E2E not re-run (backend-only request), but code review of App.js lines 480-481 confirms the catch block reads err?.response?.data?.detail and falls back to the generic message only when detail is not a string - so the new 429 body will be surfaced verbatim to the user. Cleanup: 30 TEST_-prefixed contact docs deleted from MongoDB; 11 remaining docs are pre-existing manual/dev entries (Test, Prof Rossi, Prof Deploy, T1..T4) left untouched. Backend restarted at the end so the limiter is clean for the main agent.

minor.issue: The custom rate_limit_handler drops the headers slowapi's default handler injects (Retry-After, X-RateLimit-*). Clients/crawlers have no machine-readable backoff hint. Low impact for a landing page, but easy to add: return JSONResponse(..., headers={'Retry-After': '3600'}).

real_client_ip trusts the client-supplied left-most X-Forwarded-For entry unconditionally, so the 5/hour limit is trivially bypassable by rotating the header (verified: 1.2.3.4, 5.6.7.8 and 77.77.77.77 each received a fresh 5-request quota from the same test machine). Behind Cloudflare the tamper-proof source is CF-Connecting-IP (or a fixed trusted-hop offset from the right of XFF). Acceptable for spam throttling on a landing page, but it is not an anti-abuse control.
Still open from iteration 2: asyncio.create_task(send_notification_email(...)) is fire-and-forget with no strong reference; prefer FastAPI BackgroundTasks.
Still open: backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS="*" (allow_credentials correctly falls back to False). Must be set to the production domain(s) before deploy.
In-memory limiter: quota resets on every restart/deploy and is per-process. If production runs >1 replica, buckets are per-replica (effectively 5*N/hour). Use storage_uri=redis:// if scaling.

issues: og-image.svg now exists and is served correctly (200 image/svg+xml), BUT og:image/twitter:image use %PUBLIC_URL%/og-image.svg which resolves to the RELATIVE '/og-image.svg' - OG/Twitter scrapers require an absolute https URL, so previews will still show no image. Use the full https://<domain>/og-image.svg. Also note many scrapers (WhatsApp, older Facebook) do not render SVG; a 1200x630 PNG/JPG is safer.
canonical is still href="/" (relative) and static across routes - must be an absolute https URL.

Still unfixed from iteration 2: sitemap <loc> values are relative ('/', '/privacy') - the sitemap protocol requires absolute URLs and Google will reject them. 'Sitemap: /sitemap.xml' in robots.txt must also be absolute.

action_items: Before deploy: set CORS_ORIGINS to the production domain(s) instead of '*'.
Make og:image / twitter:image / canonical / sitemap <loc> / robots Sitemap absolute https URLs (og-image.svg itself is fine now); consider a PNG for wider scraper support.

Optional hardening: add Retry-After to the 429 response and prefer CF-Connecting-IP (or a trusted-hop XFF index) over the raw left-most XFF entry, since the current key can be spoofed to bypass the limit.
Optional: replace asyncio.create_task for the Resend notification with BackgroundTasks.
critical_code_review_comments: real_client_ip is implemented correctly for its stated purpose (left-most XFF with get_remote_address fallback) and is also reused in the honeypot log line - consistent.

rate_limit_handler is registered via app.add_exception_handler(RateLimitExceeded, ...) and app.state.limiter is set; the decorator-based limiter works without SlowAPIMiddleware and verified end-to-end through the ingress.
422 validation errors still do not consume limiter quota (Pydantic rejects before the endpoint body) - good.
App.js is 610+ lines holding every section component; still worth splitting into /components before further feature work.

success_rate.backend: 100% (33/33 pytest tests pass; all 3 iteration-2 fixes verified)
success_rate.frontend: not tested this iteration (backend-only request); Contact catch-block verified by code review only

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests SERIALLY after restarting backend: sudo supervisorctl restart backend && cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -n 0 -q --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. tests/test_rate_limit.py now spoofs X-Forwarded-For (1.2.3.4 / 5.6.7.8 / 9.9.9.x) so it no longer burns the real test-machine IP quota, but it still relies on a freshly restarted in-memory limiter for the first test. Rate-limit bucket separation, JSON 'detail' 429 body, og-image.svg, honeypot and valid-submit persistence are all confirmed working. Remaining open items are SEO absolute-URL fixes and CORS_ORIGINS - frontend/HTML only, no backend retest needed.
rca_of_the_issue: No new defects. Iteration-2 RCA (slowapi get_remote_address returning the k8s/Cloudflare proxy pod IP, collapsing all visitors into one bucket) is resolved by the new real_client_ip key_func: verified that three distinct X-Forwarded-For values each hold an independent 5/hour bucket simultaneously, and that the custom handler returns the Italian 'detail' message the Contact component renders.
